tool_description: Return compact deterministic details for one exact production incident, including its identity, status, downtime, and its own repair information when available. Raw snapshots and measurement payloads remain backend-only and are not exposed through MCP.
server_instruction: Use get_incident_details when the user asks for the complete information about one specific incident. incident_id is required. Preserve the exact incident identifier. The tool returns stored deterministic evidence for that incident only; do not treat it as historical repair experience from other incidents or as official resolution guidance.

field_descriptions.incident_id: Required exact production incident ID, for example INC-000003.
